canonical_topic: Physical Storage Ownership as an Operational Commitment
definition: Owning a physical natural gas storage facility is not a purely financial position — it requires hiring an operations team for the life of the contract to coordinate physical delivery and sale of gas.
core_idea: Even when much of the trading exposure is hedged ahead of time in the futures market, physical storage ownership still carries an ongoing operational and staffing burden distinct from a financial trading position.
key_points: The example cites a 20-year commitment to keep an operations staff in place.
Substantial daily housekeeping is required regardless of how much trading is pre-arranged via futures.
relationships: Part of the execution stage of the Natural Gas Storage Arbitrage Bid Strategy example.
